mil7.7.2:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, thanasitadārakassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. -
mil7.7.2:1.2: Yathā mahārāja thanasitadārako sakatthe laggati, khīratthiko rodati,
mil7.7.2:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sadatthe laggitabbaṃ, sabbattha dhammañāṇena bhavitabbaṃ, uddese paripucchāya sammappayoge paviveke garusaṃvāse kalyāṇamittasevane.
mil7.7.2:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja thanasitadārakassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.2:1.5: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Dīghanikāyavare Parinibbānasuttante:
mil7.7.2:2.1: Ingha tumhe Ānanda sadatthe ghaṭatha, sadatthe anuyuñjatha, sadatthe appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharathāti.
